_readme: Copy to check.config.json and adapt it. The secret key is NOT in it: it is read from the variable named by service_role_key_env (default SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY).
sb_publishable_ / sb_secret_ keys: sent in the apikey header only. Legacy keys (anon / service_role JWT) are accepted, but Supabase deprecates them by the end of 2026.
Reading the keys from the CLI: supabase projects api-keys --project-ref <ref>
Expected values are written 'resource@identity'. Possible values:
0    the resource must be invisible to this identity
>0   at least one row must be visible
<n>  an exact number — use only on a frozen corpus
Prefer 0 and >0: the corpus varies from one environment to another, the access rules do not.
That is what lets you replay the same check on the source and on the target.
